column1: # Contamination check on the competition-math read. Each recipe is read at its cap on the $213$ problems from 2025 contests and on the $63$ from AIME 2026 and HMMT February 2026. The two later contests postdate every model's release. \finB{} is shown as base$\to$RL
column2: and $\Delta$ is the change in pass@1. Reach is net of the mirror. The last column is the difference in net reach between the two strata. That difference carries a bootstrap interval over problems resampled within each stratum.
